properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 921309 - Medium Affected: UNKNOWN - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 921309
Incident Time: 2009-10-19 17:00:00
Nearest City: NY
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: UNKNOWN
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
UNITED STATES COAST GUARD SECTOR LONG ISLAND SOUND RECEIVED A REPORT FROM A DIVE CHARTER CAPTAIN OF AN OIL DISCHARGE IN THE GENERAL VICINITY OF A SUNKEN VESSEL APPROXIMATELY 33 MILES SOUTH OF SHINNECOCK INLET. THE LOCATION REPORTED IS CONSISTENT WITH A KNOWN WWII ERA WRECK, M/T COIMBRA, WHICH WAS SUNK IN 1942 BY A GERMAN SUBMARINE. properties.title: NRC Report: Oil, Fuel: No. 2 in Dark Head Cove near Baltimore, MD
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 900722 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: CONSOLIDATED ENGINEERING SERVICES
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 900722
Incident Time: 2005-02-16 11:40:00
Nearest City: Baltimore, MD
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL, FUEL: NO. 2
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: CONSOLIDATED ENGINEERING SERVICES
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 15 feet by 45 feet (area 675 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 1076 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0.02 gallons
A MAINTENANCE MANAGER IDENTIFIED A LARGE HEATING OIL SPILL IN THE LOWER HANGAR 1& 2. THE MARYLAND NATIONAL GUARD FIRE AND RESCUE WAS NOTIFIED FOR ASSISTANCE. THEN BEGAN NOTIFICATIONS TO THE AIRPORT OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT TO CONTACT OTHER AGENCIES INCLUDING THE MARYLAND DEPARTMENT SPILL RESPONSE GROUPS. HANGAR TENANTS AND EMPLOYES WERE EVACUATED FROM THE BUILDING WHILE CLEANUP COMMERCED. CLEAN HARBORS INC. RESPONDED TO THE SITE FOR THE MAA TO PERFORM CLEANUP ACTIVITIES AND TO PLACE HARBOR BOOMS AND ABSORBENT BOOMS AND PADS IN WHERE SOME OIL HAD ENTERED STORM DRAIN LINES. MDE ESTIMATED UP 100 GALLONS OF OIL COULD HAVE REACHED A STORM DRAIN SYSTEM. IT APPEARS THAT CONSOLIDATED ENGINEERING SERVICES HAD BEEN WORKING ON A SMALL OIL LEAK ON THE BOILER SYSTEM LOCATED IN THE LOWER LEVEL BOILER ROOM HANGAR 2 ON FEBRUARY 15TH, 2005. THE OPERATOR REMOVED A SMALL SECTION OF OIL DELIVERY PIPE AND WAS IN THE PROCESS OF REPLACING THE SECTION WHEN HE FOUND THE NEW PIPE WAS NOT AVAILABLE AT W.W. GRAINGER AND WOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR PICK UP THE FOLLOWING DAY. HE ALLEGEDLY LEFT THE WORK SITE FOR THE DAY WITHOUT CAPPING OFF THE PIPE OR LOCKING OUT THE SWITCH THAT WOULD PREVENT THE OIL PUMPS FROM BEING ENERGIZED. 1203 GALLONS OF CONTAMINATED FLUID (SANITARY AND OIL) WERE RECOVERED FROM THE SANITARY PUMP STATION AND 776 GALLONS OF FUEL OIL WERE REMOVED THE SITE. CLEAN HARBOR KEPT THE HARBOR BOOMS AND ABSORBENT BOOMS IN PLACE FOR APPROXIMATELY 2 WEEKS TO RECOVER ANY TRACE OF OIL OR SHEEN FROM THE SITE. THE MAA IDENTIFIED THIS SPILL WAS NOT REPORTED TO THE NRC DURING ENVIRONMENTAL AUDIT BEING PERFORMED AS PART OF AN EPA AGREEMENT. THIS NOTIFICATION IS TO CLOSE OUT AND WILL BE REPORTED TO THE EPA.

Report Description///NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: SEWER LINE BREAK | DISTRICT OF STEWART | BEAR RIVER, BC NWE DGIR 260225/// DESCRIPTION OF SPILL SITE AND SURROUNDING AREA: SPILLED INTO A GRAVEL PARKING AREA - NO WATERWAYS IMPACTED. DESCRIPTION OF SPILL SOURCE, CIRCUMSTANCES, CAUSE AND ADVERSE EFFECTS OF THE SPILL: SOURCE OF THE SPILL IS A BREAK IN THE SEWER LINE BUT THE CAUSE IS UNKNOWN AND WILL BE INVESTIGATED TOMORROW. DETAILS OF ACTION TAKEN OR PROPOSED: CALLER ADVISED THEY HAVE CONTAINED AREA AND HAVE VAC TRUCKS ON SITE CLEANING UP. THEY ARE PUMPING ANYTHING LEFT FROM THE STATION TO LIFT STATION 2. ENV SDO REPORTS THAT A HATCH IN STATION 2 HAS FAILED DUE TO OVERWHELMING VOLUME, RESULTING IN SEWAGE DISCHARGING FROM A SINGLE RELEASE POINT. RAW SEWAGE MIXED WITH GROUNDWATER IS THREATENING NEARBY RESIDENCES AND MAY NECESSITATE EVACUATIONS. CREWS ARE CURRENTLY ON SCENE CONSTRUCTING BERMS AND PLACING SANDBAGS TO PREVENT SEWAGE FROM IMPACTING HOMES AND TO DIVERT FLOWS TOWARD THE MARSH AND INTO THE BEAR RIVER. THE DISCHARGE IS ONGOING, AND THERE IS CURRENTLY NO VIABLE OPTION TO FULLY ISOLATE OR SHUT OFF THE RELEASE, AS DOING SO WOULD CAUSE SEWAGE TO BACK UP INTO RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES.
